user.title: Bonaire MyClimate
user.description: Enter the IP address of the MyClimate Wi-Fi module, or leave it blank to scan your network for it. Giving the module a fixed address (a DHCP reservation on your router) keeps things reliable.

confirm.title: Module found
confirm.description: Found a MyClimate Wi-Fi module at {host} (serial {serial}). Add it?

error.invalid_host: That is not a valid IPv4 address.
error.cannot_connect: The module did not answer at that address. Check the address, that the module is powered, and that it is on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.not_found: No MyClimate module answered the network scan. Check it is powered and on the same network as Home Assistant, or enter its IP address.
error.port_in_use: TCP port 10003 is already in use on this Home Assistant host.
